Measure:
Amendment 1 — Legislative term limits
Would increase the limit for Nebraska state senators from two consecutive four-year terms (8 years) to three (12 years).

Initiative 440 — Legalize online sports betting
Would amend the state constitution to allow online sports betting through platforms affiliated with licensed racetrack casinos.

Initiative 441 — Tax online sports betting
Would change state law to permit online sports betting and establish a 20% tax, with most revenue going toward property tax relief.

Initiative 442 — Transgender participation in youth sports
Would require K-12 schools and colleges to establish sex-separate athletic teams and sports.
